title: Mastroeni backs Real Salt Lake 'to put their best foot forward against anyone'
subtitle: Real Salt Lake's playoff push continues with an away clash against Austin FC, who are unlikely to qualify for the postseason.
paragraphs: Pablo Mastroeni believes his Real Salt Lake side can "put their best foot forward against anyone" as they look to surge into the playoff places.
RSL are 10th in the Western Conference ahead of a trip to Austin FC, just two points behind the Los Angeles Galaxy, who have played one game more.
Mastroeni's side are in good form heading into the final three games of the regular season, winning three of their last five matches, including their last two.
After a 3-1 victory over Sporting Kansas City, RSL defeated in-form St. Louis City 3-0 at home after a brace from Sergi Solans and a strike from Dominik Marczuk.
RSL were handed a further boost as club captain Justen Glad made his first appearance since May after suffering a groin injury.
Amid their recent form and with key players returning to fitness, Mastroeni is optimistic his side can take on anyone in the league.
"I'll back this group to be able to put their best foot forward against anyone," Mastroeni said. "Given the way we're playing and the mentality that the group has."
"I think in all phases, we played fantastic [against St. Louis City]. But we have got no time to celebrate.
"We have got to win out. That was a good performance to build upon."
Austin are not yet out of playoff contention, but despite a 2-1 win over Sporting KC, their chances are slim.
With three games to go, Austin are seven points off the final playoff spot in 14th, with a win in this fixture necessary if they are to keep their hopes alive.
Austin FC – Myrto Uzuni
Uzuni scored both goals in Austin's win at Sporting KC on Saturday, the second player to score multiple goals in a match for Austin since the start of last season.
Austin's three multi-goal performances since the start of last season are the fewest in MLS in that time.
Real Salt Lake – Sergi Solans
Solans scored twice for Real Salt Lake on Saturday, his third multi-goal game of the season.

Only four RSL players have had more than three multi-goal games in a single season: Jeff Cunningham (four) in 2006, Alvaro Saborio (five) in 2012, Cristian Arango (five) in 2024 and Andres Gomez (four) in 2024.
MATCH PREDICTION: DRAW
Austin snapped a five-match winless run (D2 L3) with a 2-1 victory at Sporting KC, but they remain winless in seven straight home matches (D3 L4), the longest such streak in club history.
Real Salt Lake is unbeaten in six straight matches against Austin (W4 D2), including winning the last two. Neither team has managed three consecutive wins over the other before.
After winning one of their previous 16 regular-season matches (D5 L10), Real Salt Lake have back-to-back wins.
RSL have a record of W7 D0 L1 when scoring three or more goals this season, while they have won just four of 23 matches when scoring fewer than three.
